control_failures.control_label: secondary containment by bund and drainage
restraint and placarding of transported loads
controlled make-up, decanting and dosing of reagents

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: improvement notice - material unwanted event control at P-8303

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control BUND_AND_DRAINAGE_CONTAINMENT: the secondary containment by bund and drainage had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.
Control LOAD_RESTRAINT_AND_PLACARDING: the restraint and placarding of transported loads was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

Control REAGENT_HANDLING_CONTROL: the controlled make-up, decanting and dosing of reagents was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the secondary containment by bund and drainage on P-8303 and TK-8311 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling airborne contaminants, specifically selecting, fit-testing and maintaining respirators. P-8303 (reagent dosing pumps) is in service for reagent make-up and dosing. The task proceeded during routine operation while the secondary containment by bund and drainage had degraded below its design intent. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 30 April 2026 a regulatory notice was issued concerning P-8303 and TK-8311 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station following routine operation.
